prompt: In a vibrant anime style, the scene unfolds at a busy airport gate where natural light floods through large windows. On the far left, a woman in a blue coat stands holding a silver suitcase, her posture upright and alert. Next to her, a child in a yellow raincoat clutches a teddy bear tightly, looking up with wide eyes. The woman in the blue coat is handing a boarding pass to the child in the yellow raincoat, creating a tender moment of preparation. Center stage, a man in a red scarf sits on a metal bench, his legs crossed casually as he reads a newspaper. Beside him, a brown dog rests its head on the man's knee, sleeping peacefully. The man in the red scarf is looking at the brown dog with a gentle smile, acknowledging the pet's presence. To the right of the bench, a businessman in a grey suit checks his wristwatch impatiently, tapping his foot against the floor. Behind him, a flight attendant in a navy uniform points toward the open gate door, directing passengers forward. The businessman in the grey suit is next to the flight attendant in the navy uniform, though they do not interact directly. Near the gate entrance, a teenager in a hoodie listens to music through large headphones, bobbing their head to an unseen rhythm. A vending machine with bright lights stands against the wall near the teenager in the hoodie, offering snacks to travelers. In the background, a pilot in a crisp white shirt walks briskly past a luggage cart loaded with three distinct suitcases. The pilot in the crisp white shirt is looking at the luggage cart, ensuring nothing is amiss. A janitor in green overalls pushes a mop bucket across the polished floor, cleaning up a small spill near the center. The janitor in green overalls is next to the mop bucket, focusing intently on the task. An elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a plastic chair near the window, knitting a colorful scarf. A parrot in a small cage sits on the armrest next to the elderly woman in the floral dress, squawking softly. The elderly woman in the floral dress is looking at the parrot in the small cage, amused by its antics. A tourist in a Hawaiian shirt takes a photo with a digital camera, capturing the bustling atmosphere. The tourist in a Hawaiian shirt is pointing at the departure board above, showing something to a companion. A security guard in a black uniform stands near the exit, observing the crowd with a stern expression. There is no snow outside the windows. There is no food being eaten by any character. There is no airplane visible on the tarmac.
